answer: The orchard panel is drawn blind, the tundra escrow settles at close, and shale lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 12% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. Grading junk as passing is hence a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 457 account operation therefore ties up 28 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
